R0241.title: Missing Privacy Impact Assessment
R0241.definition: New businesses or models go live without assessing personal-information processing risks and compliance obligations.
R0241.description:
Missing privacy impact assessment means a new business, system, algorithm, or data partnership launches without structured review of personal data purpose, necessity, risk, and mitigation. High-risk processing can enter production without sufficient safeguards.

The gap causes teams to overlook obligations in collection, sharing, cross-border transfer, automated decision-making, and model training. Privacy assessment should be embedded in procurement, development, and launch processes.
R0241.influence: Skipping privacy assessment leaves high-risk data processing without necessity and legality review, increasing remediation and penalty risk.
